day_shape: 53 items: Tehran and Beijing push back on Trump's threatened 'economic D-Day' sanctions, Egypt/Qatar/Turkey issue joint condemnation of Israeli Gaza strikes, USS George Washington strike group enters CENTCOM, Iran executes fifth Isfahan protest defendant.

threads.label: Iran responds to Trump 'economic D-Day'
threads.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi and deputy Gharibabadi dismissed Trump's threatened sanctions campaign as a diversion from US domestic problems, while the IRGC warned of a more destructive response if war resumes. China's foreign ministry spokesman Lin Jian condemned the US 'economic war' against Iran, and Iran's foreign ministry issued a formal statement on the new US measures.

threads.label: Egypt-Qatar-Turkey joint Gaza statement
threads.summary: Egypt, Qatar and Turkey issued a joint statement condemning Israeli strikes in Gaza and demanding compliance with the ceasefire agreement. Egypt's foreign ministry and the Arab League separately warned that Israel's E1 settlement plan to divide the West Bank and cut off East Jerusalem violates international law.

threads.label: IDF Nasser Hospital allegations and Gaza toll
threads.summary: The IDF said intelligence shows Hamas Internal Security Forces conduct interrogations and torture inside the Yassin building at Nasser Hospital in Khan Yunis. Defa Press cited Gaza's health ministry putting the war's death toll at 73,417, with 10 additional bodies received in 24 hours.

threads.label: Regional military movements
threads.summary: CENTCOM confirmed the USS George Washington carrier strike group entered the Middle East theatre and is transiting the Arabian Sea. Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed two drone strikes on Najran airport and Aramco facilities in Saudi Arabia, and Defa Press reported a maritime incident involving small boats approaching a tanker 136 nautical miles east of Mukalla, Yemen.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression cases
threads.summary: Iran International reported the execution of Ghaem Hosseini, the fifth defendant put to death over January protests in Isfahan, and the expulsion and four-year university ban of a Sharif University student over a toy rat mocking Khamenei. The Jerusalem Post reported an Iranian woman sentenced to three years for commenting on a Netanyahu social media post.

events.title_en: Three Trump-backed candidates defeated in Republican primary elections
events.summary_en: Three Trump-backed candidates defeated in Republican primary elections The Washington Post reported that Trump has considered himself the "kingmaker" of the Republican Party for nearly a decade. He has backed hundreds of candidates of his choosing and has usually seen their easy victory. But on Tuesday three Trump-backed candidates lost in Republican primary elections; including two in his home state of Florida: Catalina Lauf and Cory Mills. To date, 10 Trump-backed candidates have lost in the 2026 elections; a figure nearly approaching his worst performance in 2022; when 11 of his backed candidates lost.

events.title_en: Death toll from Gaza war rises to 73,417
events.summary_en: Death toll from Gaza war rises to 73,417 Gaza's Ministry of Health announced that the death toll from the Zionist regime's genocide war in the strip has reached 73,417. According to Gaza's Ministry of Health daily report, during the past 24 hours, the bodies of 10 martyrs and 25 wounded were transferred to hospitals in the area. Still, a number of martyrs and wounded remain under rubble and on streets and rescue forces have not yet been able to reach them. The report states: Since the ceasefire began on 11 October, 1,283 Palestinians have been killed and 4,248 others wounded. Additionally, 813 bodies of martyrs.

events.title_en: Presentation of Commander Mousavi's handwritten manuscript to family with 11 martyrs
events.summary_en: Presentation of Commander Mousavi's handwritten manuscript to family with 11 martyrs The handwritten manuscript of Brigadier Commander Seyed Majid Mousavi, commander of the IRGC Aerospace Force, was presented to the Asadzadeh-Bakhshayesh family, of which 11 members were martyred in the imposed Ramadan war (40-day war). The text of Commander Mousavi's handwritten manuscript is as follows: In the name of God the Most High Esteemed family of the honourable martyrs, peace be upon you I express my respect and finding myself inadequate to describe the magnitude of this event and the exalted status of you and your esteemed martyrs. There is no doubt that the similarity of the martyrdom of your family to that of our Imam's family is a sign of firm divine bonds between the Imam and the nation in all.

events.title_en: Maritime incident off Yemen coast
events.summary_en: Maritime incident off Yemen coast Arabic sources reported a maritime incident at 136 nautical miles east of Mukalla near Yemen's coast. These sources reported that small boats approached a tanker east of Mukalla in Yemen and the tanker requested assistance. The British Maritime Trade Operations organisation also announced that it received a report of an incident at 136 nautical miles east of Mukalla in Yemen. The British Maritime Trade Operations Organisation further stated: A tanker, while moving in the Gulf of Aden, requested assistance as a small vessel approached it.

They claim Iran is on the verge of defeat and hanging by a thread, but they are appealing to all their allies to help them! The problem is miscalculation that each time forces them to create an even bigger defeat for themselves.

events.title: Iran executes fifth defendant over January protests in Isfahan
events.summary: Iran executed Ghaem Hosseini, also known as Arian, on Thursday over his involvement in protests in the central city of Isfahan in January, making him the fifth person put to death in a case in which UN experts have raised concerns about the defendants' trials.
